title: Cross-session messaging reliability and coordination metadata
outcome: Field feedback from FableLegal after roughly 40 cross-session exchanges with LegalCodex found recurring stale-reply, resend, truncation, and safety-stop problems. Track the improvements needed to preserve TermAl's asynchronous FIFO email-like model while adding batch delivery, identity and sequencing metadata, queue visibility, reliable full-message retrieval, optional request/reply notification, and narrowly scoped urgent delivery.
acceptance: Each ranked field request is independently tracked and can be prioritized or delivered without losing the shared asynchronous-channel design constraints. End-to-end tests cover queued delivery, active-turn delivery where applicable, metadata persistence, truncation recovery, and cross-repository isolation.
